runs.label: with-ee

tracker.adaptive_lead: bounded 0–1 s during preparation; frozen during welding
tracker.preparation_braking: command stays inside finite path extrema with acceleration-bounded braking
tracker.small_weld_motion: nominal targets retained; no host PID lead below minimum_weld_travel_deg

arm_configuration.sequence: Explicit supported gun-load commissioning; calculate and start each weld recovery through the weld panel.
arm_configuration.timing_note: Supported jogging defaults to 5 deg/s. The keyboard --speed-trial option permits staged manual trials up to 10 deg/s. Hardware qualification pending.
arm_configuration.limits_basis: Protocol bounds for disabled probing. Manual session windows are not calibrated mechanical limits.
arm_configuration.4340p_guard_basis: Operator-selected A2/A3 30 Nm and A4-A6 10 Nm trips on the verified physical rig routes. Expanded MC02 capability 0x800000 and matching physical TMAX readback required. Reactive trips are not drive current clamps or continuous ratings.
arm_configuration.test_scope: Gun-attached torque and temperature recording. No overload-duration cutoff is added. Existing instantaneous torque, 80 degC temperature, speed, tracking, freshness and communication stops remain.
arm_configuration.speed_guard_basis: A1-A6 measured-speed trips are 1.5 rad/s. A1 matches the existing A2-A6 setting at the operator's request. Supported jog commands remain 5 deg/s; trial command speeds are independent of these reactive guards.

torque_policy.basis: Operator-confirmed gun-load trial. No manufacturer-qualified continuous overload or peak duty cycle is established. TMAX changes encoding only; it does not raise motor current/gain/thermal settings. Verify all five physical ranges after power cycling motor power and MC02.

limitations: Torque is drive-reported feedback, not independently calibrated shaft torque.
Statistics are sample-weighted; gaps and rejected samples remain explicit.
Match physical start, route, settings, support contact and temperatures before attributing changes to payload.
An open journal has no final shutdown result; summary does not stop or contact the motor owner.
